name: Luminello

lifecycle.notes: Acquired by SimplePractice in 2021, continues to operate as a separate platform

short_description: Psychiatry-focused EHR with e-prescribing including EPCS, medication management, telehealth, and Wiley Treatment Planners integration.
long_description: Luminello is a cloud-based EHR and practice management platform designed specifically for psychiatrists and mental health professionals. Founded in 2014 and acquired by SimplePractice in 2021, Luminello focuses on the unique needs of prescribing mental health providers. The platform features comprehensive medication management with e-prescribing and EPCS (Electronic Prescribing of Controlled Substances) via DrFirst integration, PDMP access, HIPAA-compliant telehealth supporting up to 15 participants with interactive features like screen sharing and digital whiteboards, clinical documentation with Wiley Treatment Planners integration, insurance billing, appointment scheduling, patient portal, and outcome tracking with PHQ-9 and GAD-7. Luminello particularly appeals to psychiatrists transitioning to private practice and residency training programs needing a psychiatry-specific EHR. The platform continues operating as a separate product under SimplePractice ownership.
one_liner: The psychiatry-focused EHR with medication management, EPCS prescribing, and telehealth for mental health prescribers.
best_for: Psychiatrists in solo or small group practice
Prescribing mental health providers wanting medication-focused EHR
not_for: Addiction treatment centers needing specialized SUD features

pricing.notes: Professional plan starts at $99/month. Premium plan with full features approximately $149/month. E-prescribing with EPCS included in pricing. Group practice discounts available.

faqs.a: Luminello pricing starts at $99/month for the Professional plan. Premium features including full telehealth and advanced reporting are approximately $149/month. E-prescribing with EPCS is included.

faqs.q: Does Luminello support EPCS for controlled substances?
faqs.a: Yes, Luminello includes EPCS (Electronic Prescribing of Controlled Substances) via DrFirst integration. This allows psychiatrists to electronically prescribe Schedule II-V medications including stimulants and benzodiazepines.

Yes, Luminello was acquired by SimplePractice in 2021. The platform continues to operate separately, focusing on psychiatrists and prescribing providers while SimplePractice serves the broader therapy market.

faqs.q: What makes Luminello different from SimplePractice?
faqs.a: Luminello is designed specifically for psychiatrists and prescribing mental health providers, with deep medication management, EPCS, and PDMP integration. SimplePractice serves the broader therapy market without prescribing features.
